content.short: Blinks Labs is an automation layer running event-triggered DeFi strategies.
content.description: Blinks Labs tracks a user's positions and then executes the rules they set, non-custodially, across DeFi venues. Execution routes through Jupiter and Hyperliquid for price discovery, route optimisation, custom slippage controls and perpetual hedging. A separate yield layer integrates Kamino and Marinade for lending, liquidation protection, SOL staking, validator selection and reward compounding. Rules can trigger on conditions such as a wallet inflow threshold, and the platform issues embedded wallets for accounts that want one.
content.meta: DeFi strategies that fire automatically when a specified onchain event occurs.
